judge.unknown: No model called {name} on your providers. Judges you can pick: {slugs}
judge.maker_unknown: The judge has to come from a maker that made neither model being compared.
judge.pick_unreachable: {judge} can't be reached. Judged blind by {auto} (auto) instead.
judge.list.hidden_note: {maker} models aren't listed. The judge has to come from a maker that made neither model being compared.
start.judge_line: Judged blind by {judge} (auto). It compares each pair without knowing which model wrote which.
start.judge_user: Judged blind by {judge}, your pick. It compares each pair without knowing which model wrote which.

receipt.caption: {trying} vs your {current}, per turn
receipt.so_far: · so far, too few to read
verdict.reason.better: {trying} did better than your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.holds_up: {trying} kept up with your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.holds_neither: {trying} kept up with your {current} on your turns, but it isn't cheaper or faster.
verdict.reason.worse: {trying} did worse than your {current} on your turns.
verdict.reason.too_close: These turns couldn't separate {trying} from your {current}.
verdict.reason.cap: Stopped at your ${cap:.2f} cap after {pairs} usable turns. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.rate_limited: {provider} turned requests down twice, so the test stopped after {pairs} usable turns. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.few_usable: Only {pairs} of {picked} turns could be used; on {unusable} both models failed or the judge's answer was unusable. Shadow needs 20.
verdict.reason.judge_unreachable: {judge} couldn't be reached, so Shadow stopped before judging any turns. Nothing was switched. Check that {judge} still works in Hermes, then start a new test.
verdict.reason.judge_unsure: {judge} picked the same way both orders on only {agree} of {pairs} turns. Shadow needs 7 in 10 before it trusts the judge.
verdict.reason.runs_varied: Your {current} differed from itself on {varied} of 10 reruns, too much for 30 turns to separate two models.
sure.luck: If the two were really even, luck would give a gap this big {luck}.
sure.worst: Worst case this test leaves open: it loses {count} more turns than it wins, per 100.
sure.even: Worst case this test leaves open: about even with yours.
sure.lean_better: It leans better, but a gap this small is easily luck.
sure.lean_worse: It leans worse, but a gap this small is easily luck.
sure.few: Too few turns to read a result from.
fine.scale: For scale: your model, run twice on {reruns} of these turns, differed from itself on {varied}.
fine.web_on: Web lookups ran for real on {count} of these turns, with the same pages for both models.
fine.web_off: Web lookups were off, so {count} turns that needed one stopped there, the same way for both models.
fine.second: Second look, {pairs} turns. The bar is higher on a second look, so an answer needs a bigger gap than before.
maths.method: Interval: wins minus losses over matched pairs, with 0.5 added to each cell (Agresti and Min, 2005). Sign test: exact binomial on won against lost. Ranges are rounded outward and the net toward zero, so the numbers never claim more than the data.
trial.switch_running: A switch is in progress. Finish it or undo it first.
trial.minimum: Shadow needs at least 20 turns for an answer.
start.service_tier: Shadow can't price this service tier, so it can't keep this test under your cap.
verdict.reason.unpriceable: The test stopped because a price was not known, so the recorded spend is incomplete.
trial.isolation: Replays are close copies of your turns, not exact re-runs.
trial.stopped: Test {id} stopped. Spent ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f}. The {done} finished turns are kept. That's too few for an answer.
trial.stopped_usable: Test {id} stopped with {done} finished turns. Spent ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f}.
trial.controller_exited: The test controller ended before the test finished. Start a new test with /shadow try {model} or hermes shadow try {model}.
trial.controller_failed: The test controller failed before the test finished. Failure reason: {reason}.
trial.controller_interrupted: The test controller was interrupted before the test finished. Finished turns and spend are saved.
trial.plugin_reloaded: Shadow reloaded before the test finished. Finished turns and spend are saved.
controller.tool_denied: This controller can only discover tools and run Shadow test steps.
trial.status: Shadow: test {id}, {done} of {picked} turns, ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f} spent.
trial.progress: Shadow test {id}: {done} of {picked} turns done · ${spend:.2f} of ${cap:.2f} spent
start.title: Try {trying} against your {current}
start.turns: {picked} of your {total} from the last {days} days, picked at random.
start.sent: {providers}: both models and the judge. {keys} keys and {emails} email addresses were removed first.
start.runs_on: Reading files in the folders those chats used, and web lookups (both models get the same pages). Anything that would change something is not run.
start.runs_off: Reading files in the folders those chats used. Web lookups are off, so a turn that needs one stops there. Anything that would change something is not run.
start.cost: About ${estimate:.2f}, capped at ${cap:.2f}. The judge is about ${judge_cost:.2f}.
start.wait: About {minutes} minutes. You can keep working.
start.preview: To see or drop any of the {picked} first, start from chat or Desktop.
start.too_few: Only {picked} of your turns from the last {days} days can be replayed. Shadow needs at least 20. To look further back: {command} try {model} --days 30
start.over_cap: This test would cost about ${estimate:.2f}, over your ${cap:.2f} cap. Even 20 turns, the fewest that can give an answer, would cost about ${minimum:.2f}. To run it, raise the cap: {command} try {model} --budget {higher}
start.plan: your plan: {tokens:,} tokens, worth about ${cost:.2f} at list price
start.no_price: Shadow doesn't have a price for {model}, so it can't keep this test under your cap. Pick another model to test.

trial.more_cost: 30 more turns might settle it, for about ${cost:.2f}.
trial.anyway: To find out on live work instead, switch gradually anyway: {command} switch {id}
pick.reason.trivial: too short to tell models apart
maths.too_wide: too wide to use: under 20 pairs
maths.holds_value: low end {low}; one-sided {level}%; Holds up needs -15% or better
maths.agree_value: {agree} of {pairs} pairs; same pick in both orders; Shadow needs 7 in 10
reason.tool_details: wrong details in a tool call
reason.weaker_action: a weaker plan at an action

doctor.setting: Missing {setting}. Set it with: hermes config set {setting} true
trial.invalid: Shadow could not read that command. Use /shadow for the commands.
trial.unavailable: Shadow could not start this test. Run the setup check.
trial.isolation_required: Replay context and memory isolation are not verified. Run the setup check before starting a test: /shadow doctor --verify or hermes shadow doctor --verify
doctor.verified: Replay context and memory isolation was checked on {date}. This Hermes and these Shadow files match that check.
doctor.verified_no_memory: Replay context and memory isolation was checked on {date}. This profile has no saved memory. The replay received no memory guidance or memory blocks. This Hermes and these Shadow files match that check.
doctor.verify_confirm: This check calls {provider} / {model} for one short turn. It reloads the running gateway's plugins unless already running inside that gateway. Continue? [y/N]
doctor.verify_pass_no_memory: The setup check passed on {date}. This profile has no saved memory. The replay received no memory guidance or memory blocks. A replay did not see this chat or your other chats. Tools that would change something were not run. A file in the working folder could be read. Secret files were refused. Your chats and memory were unchanged.
doctor.verify_pass: The setup check passed on {date}. A replay did not see your memory, this chat, or your other chats. Tools that would change something were not run. A file in the working folder could be read. Secret files were refused. Your chats and memory were unchanged.
doctor.verify_fail: The setup check did not pass. Nothing was saved.
doctor.verify_timeout: The setup check timed out and could not complete. No setup verification was saved.
doctor.verify_incomplete: The setup check could not complete because no complete result was received. No setup verification was saved.
doctor.verify_one: Run one check at a time.
doctor.pair_unavailable: The pair check is not available. Nothing was called.
doctor.pair_confirm: This check runs two live Hermes turns on {provider}, first {old_model}, then {new_model} with the first turn's full history. The second request must carry the reply without replaying sealed reasoning. Continue? [y/N]
doctor.pair_context_engine: The pair check needs Hermes's built-in context engine to keep your stored context unchanged. Nothing was called.
doctor.pair_pass: This pair completed two live Hermes turns with carried history and the first reply. No sealed reasoning was replayed. Shadow saved the check.
doctor.pair_fail: The live pair check did not save a compatibility approval. A completed check may have left diagnostic evidence.
doctor.pair_required: Choose the exact old and new models with doctor --verify-pair <old-model> <new-model> --provider <provider>, or save an eligible test first. Nothing was called.
tool.shadow_setup_check: Run the setup check in this chat.
trial.switch_unavailable: No switch is available. Nothing changed.
trial.switch_routes_conflict: No switch is available because the model routes changed during this test.
trial.switch_routes_missing: No switch is available because this test did not verify both model routes.
trial.switch_incompatible: These models use different request formats or endpoints on the same provider, so this switch isn't supported. Nothing changed.
trial.switch_compatibility: Gradual switching is waiting for the exact model pair to pass its compatibility check. Run hermes shadow doctor --verify-pair to check it. Nothing changed.
trial.switch_watch: {trying} is on another provider ({provider}), so the switch can't be gradual. Shadow watches the next 20 turns and switches back if it breaks. That catches breakage, not a small drop.
doctor.other_model: Missing: at least one other model to try
doctor.judge: Third-maker judge: unavailable. Missing a model that can act as judge from a third maker.

tool.shadow_search: Search text in files in the working folder.
tool.shadow_web: Look up a search or page.

turns.more: and {count} more on the Shadow page in Hermes Desktop.
trial.tools_unavailable: Some tools are unavailable in this test. Where you would use one, say exactly what you would run.
judge.threshold_invalid: Shadow needs judge_swap_consistency_min to be a percentage from 0 to 100.
start.judge_contestant: Backup judging: both models judge each pair blind, in both orders. A turn counts only when both pick the same winner.
fine.contestant: Backup judging: both models judged each pair blind. Each may favour answers like its own, so a turn counts as won or lost only when both picked the same winner.
fine.low_panel_agreement: The judges often disagreed on these turns, so read this result loosely. The turns are saved if you want to look.
verdict.reason.judge_ineligible: No judge picked the same winner in both orders often enough to trust.
verdict.reason.panel_uncertain: The likely range still includes an even split.
sure.bootstrap: On your turns, the new model likely wins {low}% to {high}% of the time, counting ties as half.
maths.bootstrap: Win rate, ties as half: {low}% to {high}% ({level}% bootstrap interval). A call needs the whole range above or below 50%.
maths.panel_agree_value: {agree} of {pairs} judge-pairs; same pick in both orders. Each judge needs {threshold}% over the run.
maths.panel_kappa: Judges agreed beyond chance: {kappa} ({method} kappa). Below 0.41 counts as low.
maths.panel_method: The verdict uses eligible judges and a seeded {level}% bootstrap interval on the win rate, with ties counted as half. Cross-judge agreement is diagnostic only. The net interval and sign test above are supplementary diagnostics.
fine.panel_second: Second look: {pairs} turns in all, judged the same way, with a stricter bar to call it.
doctor.pair_cross_provider: The saved test uses different providers. Gradual pair verification needs two models on the same provider. [cross_provider_pair] Nothing was called.
verdict.rate.label: win rate {point}% ({level}% CI {low}–{high}%)
